name: Granátula de Calatrava (Spain)
description: Five horizontal stripes of red, white, red, white and red, the central red stripe narrow, charged at the centre with the crowned municipal arms of Granátula de Calatrava (a cross of Calatrava and a flower on blue).
history: Municipal flag of Granátula de Calatrava; Spanish municipal flags are approved by the municipal council and the autonomous community and published in the regional official gazette.

features.role: Granátula de Calatrava arms — cross of Calatrava and flower
